title: Let Samples Speak: Mitigating Spurious Correlation by Exploiting the Clusterness of Samples
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology (Neutralizing Spurious Features) for debiasing deep learning models. While it utilizes the CivilComments-WILDS dataset, which includes religious identity (e.g., Christian, Muslim) as a spurious attribute for testing, the paper is an algorithmic study on mitigating statistical bias rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics themselves.
